subject: Online orders not syncing to POS terminal since 3:45 PM — Swiggy and Zomato orders stuck in pending state
description: Since approximately 15:45 IST today, online orders placed through Swiggy and Zomato are not syncing to our POS terminal (POS-0052-T1). Orders are visible in the respective third-party partner dashboards but do not appear in FoodTech POS v4.2.2. Currently, there are 12 unacknowledged orders in the Swiggy queue and 8 in the Zomato queue. Kitchen staff have been manually taking orders via phone, causing service delays and customer dissatisfaction. Error message displayed on POS terminal when attempting manual sync: "Sync Error 0x4E2 — API Connection Timeout. Unable to fetch orders from partner gateway." Steps already attempted: (1) Restarted POS terminal twice, (2) Verified internet connectivity — stable at 45 Mbps download/8 Mbps upload, (3) Checked FoodTech sync logs showing repeated "Connection refused" responses from partner API endpoints, (4) Attempted manual order import function — returns same timeout error. Business impact is high: online channels represent approximately 35% of daily revenue for this store. Immediate resolution needed to prevent further order cancellations and customer complaints.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Confirmed internet connectivity is stable and POS terminal is online. Escalated to L2 technical team due to repeated API timeout errors and business impact confirmation.
Escalation flag activated. Ticket assigned to L2 Network & Integration team for investigation of partner API gateway connectivity issue.
